summary.overview: Zero forbidden claims (0 matches across all data/type files) and 100% visual pass on the circular-masked logo badge and all 5 Nano 2 architectural WebP renders. However, Gate 1 caught 3 P0 cross-file blockers (4 broken guide heroImage paths that will 404, 4 non-canonical /services/* routes + regular slug mismatch, and 13 misaligned Room X-Ray hotspot coordinates in site_copy.json vs visually measured media_manifest.json), 3 P1 compliance/consistency gaps (adFunnels['pet-safe'] heroVisualSlot key mismatch, 3 standalone Area Hub FAQs + Move-Out descaling copy missing the full surface-safety warning, and Stony Plain FSA listed as T7Y instead of T7Z), and 4 P2 preventative polish items.

All typography ('LEVELUP CLEANING') and house/eucalyptus line art sit well inside the sage-green outer ring with zero clipping. Radial pixel audit confirms 0 opaque corner pixels and pure sage-green outer edge pixels (r=123..125px RGB ~[125,141,124,255], r=126px RGB [121,139,121,149], r=127px RGB [121,137,119,25], r=128px fully transparent) — zero cream/beige halo on dark #172A22 Cedar Spruce.

findings.title: All 4 Guide heroImage paths in site_copy.json use underscores and '-1024.webp' instead of hyphenated '-1024w.webp' (HTTP 404 on disk)
findings.impact: None of the 4 referenced files exist in website/public/media/photos/. Every /guides/* article hero image, Guides index card thumbnail, and OG image derived from guide.heroImage will return 404.
findings.fixInstructions: In website/src/data/site_copy.json (lines 838, 905, 964, 1024), replace underscore slugs and '-1024.webp' suffixes with the exact hyphenated '-1024w.webp' paths from media_manifest.json -> $.photos.*.variants['1024'].webp.path.

findings.title: Service routePath values in site_copy.json use '/services/*' prefix and 'regular-house-cleaning-edmonton' instead of canonical root SEO routes
findings.impact: Internal navigation links, service cards, canonical tags, JSON-LD Service URLs, BreadcrumbList items, and sitemap entries reading site_copy.services.*.routePath or slug will point to non-canonical '/services/*' URLs and '/services/regular-house-cleaning-edmonton', causing 404s or SEO canonical split.
findings.fixInstructions: In website/src/data/site_copy.json (lines 168, 245, 317–318, 390), strip the '/services' prefix on all 4 routePath fields and update $.services.regular.slug to 'recurring-cleaning-edmonton' and $.services.regular.routePath to '/recurring-cleaning-edmonton'.

findings.title: All 13 Room X-Ray hotspot (xPct, yPct) coordinates in site_copy.json contradict the visually measured coordinates in media_manifest.json
findings.impact: site_copy.json contains pre-image blind guesses: e.g., 'oven' (24,68) lands on the quartz island, 'sink' (52,54) lands on the oven door, 'grout' (38,62) lands on dry grey wall, and 'vent_baseboard' (86,86) lands on the oak vanity drawer. Because HotspotItem in contracts.ts carries xPct/yPct directly, RoomXRay pins will point to wrong features if bound to site_copy.roomXRay.
findings.fixInstructions: Sync all 7 $.roomXRay.kitchenHotspots and all 6 $.roomXRay.bathroomHotspots (xPct, yPct) pairs in website/src/data/site_copy.json (lines 709–822) to match website/src/data/media_manifest.json -> $.xrayHotspots.{kitchen,bathroom}.targets 1:1.

findings.title: strategy.json adFunnels['pet-safe'] heroVisualSlot uses 'realPetSupervisorReel' instead of media_manifest.json key 'pet_supervisors'
findings.impact: While move-out ('moveout_condo') and deep-reset ('hero_kitchen') match media_manifest.json keys directly, 'realPetSupervisorReel' comes from site_context_lock.json -> existingAssets and does not exist in media_manifest.json (where the video key is 'pet_supervisors'). Dynamic AdFunnelLayout media lookup against media_manifest.json will fail on /lp/pet-safe.

findings.title: 3 standalone Area Hub FAQs and Move-Out descaling copy mention vinegar, acids, or descaling without the complete mandatory surface-safety warning

currentValue.$.areaHubs[1].faqs[0].answer: Mentions 'never bleach, abrasives, or vinegar on stone or hardwood' without 'safe ONLY on sealed ceramic/porcelain tile or chrome mesh', 'travertine', 'marble', 'unsealed grout', 'matte-black/brass fixtures', or 'always spot-test first'.
currentValue.$.areaHubs[2].faqs[0].answer: Mentions 'vinegar, lemon, or acidic bathroom sprays' without 'safe ONLY on sealed ceramic/porcelain tile or chrome mesh' or 'quartz, hardwood, unsealed grout, or matte-black/brass fixtures'.
currentValue.$.areaHubs[2].faqs[1].answer: Mentions 'vinegar mixtures' without the full surface-safety warning and 'spot-test first'.
currentValue.$.services.move_out.checklistByRoom.bath: Mentions 'descaled safely for EPCOR hard-water spots' while /move-out-cleaning-edmonton has no surface-safety disclaimer anywhere in its copy or FAQs.

findings.expectedValue: Every FAQ answer or service section referencing vinegar, citric/lemon acid, baking soda, or descaling includes the explicit guardrail: 'Safe ONLY on sealed ceramic/porcelain tile or chrome mesh; NEVER use vinegar or acids on marble, travertine, natural stone, quartz, hardwood, unsealed grout, or matte-black/brass fixtures; always spot-test first.'
findings.impact: Violates levelup-brand-rules Section 4. Because Area Hub and Service FAQs are emitted into standalone FAQPage JSON-LD schema for Google/GEO AI answers, partial chemistry answers could be surfaced without the mandatory surface exclusion list.
findings.fixInstructions: Append the canonical surface-safety sentence ('Note: vinegar and acids are safe ONLY on sealed ceramic/porcelain tile or chrome mesh; NEVER use vinegar or acids on marble, travertine, natural stone, quartz, hardwood, unsealed grout, or matte-black/brass fixtures; always spot-test first.') to $.areaHubs[1].faqs[0].answer, $.areaHubs[2].faqs[0].answer, $.areaHubs[2].faqs[1].answer, and add a surface-safety FAQ or checklist note on $.services.move_out.

findings.title: site_copy.json areaHubs[3] labels Stony Plain as FSA 'T7Y' instead of 'T7Z' and omits T7Z/T8L from fsaCodes

currentValue.parkingAndAccessNotesSnippet: Spruce Grove (T7X), Stony Plain (T7Y), Leduc (T9E), Beaumont (T4X), Fort Saskatchewan (T8L)

expectedValue.parkingAndAccessNotesSnippet: Spruce Grove (T7X, T7Y), Stony Plain (T7Z), Leduc (T9E), Beaumont (T4X), Fort Saskatchewan (T8L)

findings.impact: Contradicts strategy.json -> $.fsaDirectory (where T7Y = 'Spruce Grove South & Parkland County' and T7Z = 'Stony Plain') and Canada Post's Alberta FSA assignments, and leaves Stony Plain (T7Z) and Fort Saskatchewan (T8L) out of $.areaHubs[3].fsaCodes despite listing both in $.areaHubs[3].neighborhoods.
findings.fixInstructions: In website/src/data/site_copy.json (lines 646 and 656), update 'Stony Plain (T7Y)' to 'Spruce Grove (T7X, T7Y), Stony Plain (T7Z)' and include 'T7Y', 'T7Z', and 'T8L' in $.areaHubs[3].fsaCodes.

findings.title: landingPages '{PROMO}' token in site_copy.json requires short '$XX OFF' string rather than full strategy.json preset.badge
findings.currentValue: Templates like 'Claim {PROMO} Your Inspection-Ready Move-Out Clean in Edmonton' and 'Lock In My {PROMO} Move-Out Rate' paired with strategy.json preset.badge values like '$25 OFF Your First Clean' or '$50 OFF December Holiday Reset'.
findings.expectedValue: Interpolate '{PROMO}' using `$${promo.discountCad} OFF` (e.g., '$50 OFF') in headlines/CTAs, while rendering full `promo.badge` separately in the pill/badge UI element.
findings.impact: If AdFunnelLayout replaces '{PROMO}' with `promo.badge`, headlines render broken grammar such as 'Claim $25 OFF Your First Clean Your Inspection-Ready Move-Out Clean in Edmonton'.
findings.fixInstructions: Ensure the promo helper / AdFunnelLayout replaces `{PROMO}` strictly with `$${discountCad} OFF` (e.g., '$25 OFF', '$50 OFF', '$100 OFF') and displays `promo.badge` only inside the standalone promo badge component.

findings.title: strategy.json edmontonMarketBenchmarks.mediansCad has no 'airbnb' key for QuoteBreakdown.competitorMedianCad
findings.expectedValue: Safe fallback in pricingEngine.ts when service === 'airbnb' (e.g., fallback to mediansCad.regular[`${bedrooms}bd`] or return competitorSavingsCad: 0) and use Math.round() on recurring discounts so 3-bed Regular bi-weekly ($215 * 0.90 = 193.5) matches areaHubs[1].sampleQuotes[0] ($194).
findings.impact: Without a null-safe guard, selecting 'airbnb' in InstantCalculator could throw a runtime TypeError reading `mediansCad[service][`${bedrooms}bd`]`, and unrounded float math could show $193.50 instead of $194.
findings.fixInstructions: In pricingEngine.ts, guard `mediansCad[service]` with fallback to `mediansCad.regular` for 'airbnb' (and `medianHourlyCad * hours * cleaners` for 'hourly'), and document rounding convention (`Math.round`).

findings.title: Inline baking-soda aluminum/stone caution in guides[1] body paragraph and evergreen summer window note on moveout-condo
findings.currentValue: Instructs applying 'a gentle warm water + baking soda paste (or non-caustic botanical degreaser) to the cool porcelain-enamel cavity—staying well clear of exposed heating elements, gas igniters, and door gaskets', while bare-aluminum, surrounding stone/quartz, and spot-test warnings appear only in $.guides[1].surfaceSafetyWarning and $.guides[1].faqs[2].answer.

findings.fixInstructions: Render `surfaceSafetyWarning` prominently on every `/guides/[slug]` page and optionally include bare-aluminum + spot-test mention inline at line 936 of website/src/data/site_copy.json.
